listings.Job Description: The Center for Quantum and Topological Systems (CQTS) at New York University Abu Dhabi (NYUAD) is seeking to recruit a Research Assistant in the area of Quantum Computing, both at the hardware and the software levels. The center is an interdisciplinary research hub that involves the Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Chemistry, Mathematics, and Physics programs. Accordingly, research can be in either of two directions: Quantum computing software or Quantum computing hardware. The project will have several independent aspects to it, leading to the possibility of working individually or as part of a team. Principal responsibilities include performing interdisciplinary research in topological and/or quantum systems, participation in center activities, and working on individualized research projects under faculty supervision. This position is supervised by Dr. Hisham and Dr. Asif.
listings.Job Requirements: Required Education: Bachelors in one of the following: Computer Science, Computer/Electrical/Communication Engineering, Mathematics, Chemistry, Physics. Preferred Education: Masters in one of the above. Required Work and Related Experience: Research experience in at least one of the following areas: Quantum software, Quantum circuits/simulations, Quantum hardware/condensed matter physics, Quantum theory/Mathematics. Preferred Work and Related Experience: Experience in or potential for interdisciplinary research.
